notes.title: 游戏更新日志：2023.7.5
notes.content:
游戏优化：
解决了游戏内转视角时卡顿的问题。
解决了纹理流送导致交互物贴图模糊的问题。
增加了ESC关闭UI界面的功能。
增加了显示游戏PING值的功能。
BUG修复：
修复了部分导致游戏流程无法进行的bug。

notes.title: "Sinister Game" will start the official EA test on the morning of June 30
notes.content:
Dear players:
        "Sinister Game" will open the emergency experience version at 10:10 am on June 30, 2023. This opening is actually a small-scale functional test. We will optimize and adjust the game according to the feedback of players. We hope that all players and With the efforts of the developers, "Sinister Game" will become more and more fun. As a werewolf-like game, you can have fun in human reasoning! All players are welcome to report problems encountered in the game through the forum or the official QQ group: "869217617", or provide suggestions for optimization of the game.
